parameters.domain: Explicit single basis per price panel, currency, adjustment/vintage and corporate-action policy; no mixing unadjusted and adjusted prices.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: Dashboard declares close; the parser prefers adjusted if supplied. Statistical data may alias close as adjustedClose.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Compare the same dated instruments across candidate conventions; identify corporate actions and revisions. Record approved source contract and material differences before binding.

parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: No V2 breadth bands exist in HEAD.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Review distributions and stability of positive-sector counts on aligned training history; preserve an interior MIXED range; demonstrate all participation states from coherent panels on held-out data.

parameters.domain: gap > 0, in percentage points of 21-session return.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: V1 compares the top two of three group means using gap=1; V2 compares non-defensive leadership versus defensive.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Validate the new economic comparison and sensitivity to gap with the same group universe. Do not inherit 1 without evidence.

parameters.domain: 0 < v_watch < v_adverse < v_stress, in VIX points.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: V1 levels include 12,16,20,25,30,40; these are descriptive module bands, not V2 validation.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Validate state coverage, shock identification and parameter sensitivity jointly with momentum and the VX curve, on temporal holdouts.

parameters.domain: jump_1 > 0; jump_5 > 0, relative percent, not VIX points.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: V1 rising_fast uses 1D >= 8 percent OR 5D >= 15 percent.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Validate joint shock/false-trigger behavior with VOLATILITY_BANDS and CURVE_BANDS. Recompute from full point-in-time histories.

parameters.domain: 0 <= curve_flat < curve_adverse, in percent of VX1.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: Legacy flat band [-2,+2], outer slope boundaries +/-5.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Validate expiry/roll effects and level/curve disagreement; use actual monthly contract identities and settlement dates, never continuous synthetic VX slots without provenance.

parameters.domain: 0 <= rho_floor < rho_high < 1; delta_rising > 0; nested 21/63-window RISING must have a realizable PSD witness.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: Legacy fragility uses rho21 >= .65 as one score term; there is no validated V2 rising band.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Use dated aligned returns and all 55 pairs. Demonstrate LOW/RISING/HIGH jointly with participation and leadership; compare level-only and level-plus-spread in ablation.

parameters.domain: Versioned source calendars, zones, publication SLAs, decision instants and cross-source date compatibility.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: TTL: 24h sector/VIX/BTC/GLD, 6h VX; legacy BTC stale >4 calendar days, GLD >5 days.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Validate expected publication behavior including weekends, holidays and failures. TTL and legacy staleness thresholds cannot substitute for this contract.

parameters.domain: Verified publication or first-observed upper bound for each exact source vintage and all raw inputs.
parameters.existing_precedent_not_approval: No per-observation available_at in Dashboard; September snapshot observed on 2026-09-06 for data through 2026-09-04.
parameters.resolution_evidence: Supply immutable captures/vintages with raw hashes and eligibility audit. A reconstruction using latest revised data does not satisfy point-in-time. Bind conservative capture-time availability where earlier publication is unproven.
